Test Title: Standard customer purchases the Sauce Labs Backpack and logs out
Preconditions: Fresh unauthenticated browser context; login page open
Test Data: Standard user and documented shared sample password; Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99); checkout: John Doe, 12345
Execution Steps: Open SauceDemo; authenticate; verify inventory URL, Products title, and six products; add Backpack; verify cart badge; open cart and verify product, price, and quantity; proceed to checkout; enter checkout details; verify overview product, quantity, subtotal, displayed tax, and total arithmetic; finish order; verify confirmation; return to products; log out
Expected Result: Successful Backpack purchase confirmation; return to inventory and logout to login page; subtotal, tax, and total add up
Actual Result: Chromium PASS (2026-10-09): purchase reached order confirmation and logout; cart/overview product and quantity matched, subtotal matched catalog price, and displayed subtotal plus tax equaled total.
